what: Hirschkorn's key (Boston GP-178, note 52) where his tables give no number for its shape: the key front and the covering's lip, the covering, the key button, where the keystick's full height ends behind the capstan, the back check block, the thinned tail and its end, the capstan's head and shank. Traced from his Figure A.1, the only drawing of the key in the thesis, as positions in pixels of the page rendered at 600 dpi; tools/derivations/11-hirschkorn-key-outline.py carries them into his key's frame by a similarity fitted on three markers whose coordinates are printed, prints the residuals at the others as the trace's uncertainty, and derives the numbers below from them.

source.author: Martin C. Hirschkorn
source.title: Dynamic Model of a Piano Action Mechanism
source.kind: MASc thesis, Systems Design Engineering, University of Waterloo, 2004
source.traced_from: Figure A.1, Defined Points on Action Components

how_read.image: 5100 by 6600 pixels: the whole page, US letter.
how_read.pixels: x to the right and y down from the page's top-left corner, in pixels of that rendering, continuous: the top-left pixel spans (0, 0) to (1, 1).
how_read.method: The figure is line art drawn as vector paths. Each position is a vertex of those paths, or the centre of a marker's ellipse (the mean of its four quadrant points), read with pdftocairo -svg -f 77 -l 77 hirschkorn_thesis.pdf a1.svg in points of the page and multiplied by 600/72 into the rendering's pixels, to 0.01 pixel. Each lies on its drawn stroke in the rendering, within a pixel. A stroke is about 0.46 point wide, half a millimetre of key; a position is its stroke's centre line.
how_read.scale: One pixel is about 0.138 mm of key: the figure draws the key at about 1:3.25.

fitted_on: Pg1, Pk2 and Pk5, the three markers whose printed coordinates are points of the key: a similarity (turn, scale and shift, the page's y running down) by least squares. Pk4 and Pk6 are points of printed lines, compared across the line; Pk3's marker sits on the dome its printed point is the centre of.

residuals_mm.what: The trace's uncertainty, as tools/derivations/11 prints it: at the three fitted markers, the distance between where the fit puts each and its printed point; at Pk4 and Pk6, points of printed lines, the distance across the line; at Pk3, the distance from the marker drawn on the capstan's dome to the dome's top, Pk3's centre raised by its radius.

Pg1.what: The centre of the small circle at the key's axes, on its underside at the balance point: the origin of the key's frame, Table A.2's Pg1, (0, 0).

Pk2.what: The tip of the downward arrow on top of the key front, which touches the covering's top: Table A.3's Pk2, where his finger presses.

Pk5.what: The centre of the ellipse drawn on the chamfer under the tail: a point of Table A.3's Pk5 line.

Pk4.what: The centre of the ellipse drawn on the underside under the key front: a point of Table A.3's Pk4 line, not its printed point.

Pk3.what: The centre of the ellipse drawn on the capstan's head, at the top of its dome: Table A.3's Pk3 is that dome's centre, its radius below.

Pk6.what: The centre of the ellipse drawn on the back check's face: a point of Table A.3's Pk6 line.

CMk.what: The centre of the key's centre-of-mass symbol.

key_front_face.what: The key front's outer face, bottom then top: the plate glued over the end grain, where key height and dip are read.

keystick_front.what: The keystick's front face behind that plate, bottom then top; its top is the keystick's top at its front.

lip.what: The covering's lip, top then bottom: its front face, overhanging the key front.

covering_back.what: The covering's back end, where it meets the keystick's top, then where its bevel reaches its top.

key_button.what: The key button over the balance point: its back foot on the keystick, the two ends of its flat top, its front foot. Its ends are drawn rounded.

full_height_end.what: Where the keystick's full height ends, behind the capstan, its top lowered from there to the key's end: the foot of the cove the figure draws it with, on the lowered top; where the cove reaches the full height's top; that top's front end, over the line drawn down the wood (line_down_the_full_height); and where that line meets the keystick's top in front of it. The full height's top behind the line is drawn 0.75 mm above the keystick's full height (stick_height), within the trace's uncertainty: one height, the keystick's. The capstan screws into it, nothing glued under it.

line_down_the_full_height.what: A line the figure draws down the full height's wood, 29.65 mm in front of where the full height ends, top then foot, its foot as low as the lowered top: the wood stands at the full height on either side of it, so it is no step down to the thinned tail.

back_check_block.what: The back check block: its back foot and back top on the lowered top, the thinned tail, its top's front end, its front foot. Its front is drawn as a cove.

tail_end.what: The key's end, top then bottom: the thinned tail's top and the chamfer's back end.

underside.what: The underside's flat: the chamfer's kink, then the flat's front end under the key front.

capstan_head.what: The capstan's head: the top and bottom of its back side, then the bottom and top of its front side; its dome is drawn above.

capstan_shank.what: The capstan's shank between its head and the keystick: the top and bottom of its back side, then the bottom and top of its front side.

records.name: front_edge
records.what: The key front's outer face, in front of the balance point: where key height and dip are read.

records.name: front_board
records.what: The key front's plate: its outer face less the keystick's front face.

records.name: keytop_overhang
records.what: How far the covering's lip stands in front of the key front: the datum every touchweight is read back from.

records.name: keytop_thickness
records.what: The covering's thickness at its lip.

records.name: keytop_length
records.what: The covering's length, from its lip back to where its bevelled end meets the keystick: drawn square there.

records.name: stick_height
records.what: The keystick's full height, from the key front to where it ends behind the capstan: Pk2's printed height less the covering, so that the covering's top passes through Pk2, the printed point on it. The keystick as drawn is 23.74 mm high, 0.28 mm less: within the trace's uncertainty.

records.name: capsule_length
records.what: The key button over the balance point, foot to foot: drawn square-ended, its ends drawn rounded.

records.name: capsule_centre
records.what: Where the key button's middle stands, behind the balance point: not on it.

records.name: capsule_height
records.what: The key button's height above the keystick.

records.name: full_height_back
records.what: Where the keystick's full height ends, behind the capstan and the balance point: from here to the key's end its top is lowered, the back check block glued on the lowered part. Drawn as a cove, taken square at its foot.

records.name: back_check_block_back
records.what: The back check block's back end, behind the balance point.

records.name: back_check_block_length
records.what: The back check block's length, foot to foot: drawn square, its front drawn as a cove.

records.name: back_check_block_height
records.what: The back check block's height above the lowered top, the thinned tail, it stands on.

records.name: tail_end
records.what: The key's end, behind the balance point.

records.name: tail_height
records.what: The lowered top's height above the underside's flat, behind the full height: the thinned tail's, read at the key's end and at the foot of the cove where the full height ends.

records.name: capstan_diameter
records.what: The capstan's shank, between its head and the keystick.

records.name: capstan_head_diameter
records.what: The capstan's head, under its dome.

records.name: capstan_head_height
records.what: The capstan's head from its bottom, as drawn, to where Pk3's dome of 9.7 mm meets its side: Pk3's height plus its radius, less the dome's sagitta over the head, less the head's drawn bottom.

not_traced.chamfer: Not traced: it is Table A.3's Pk5 line, printed. It meets the underside's flat, Pk4's line, at -196.43 mm; the figure draws the kink at -195.57 mm.
not_traced.capstan_dome: Not traced: Table A.3's Pk3, a circle of 9.7 mm about (-117.6, 25.9) mm. The figure draws its top 1.0 mm from where Pk3 puts it.
not_traced.back_check: Its wire and head, on the key behind the back check block, are drawn and not traced: they are the action's, part of the key's published mass, and the key on its frame touches nothing with them.
not_traced.mass: Table A.1 gives the key's mass and centre of mass. The figure's CMk marker stands 13.7 mm behind Table A.1's centre and 3.8 mm lower; the record never takes the marker for the mass.
